 r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),'sources/'+n+'.txt'],input=z.stdout,text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0
 print(n,'CHARS',len(z.stdout))

a=json.loads(Path('historical-results-allowlist.json').read_text());p=str(lane.parent/'expanded-corpus-r277/results.json');assert p in a
